name: The Castles of Burgundy: Special Edition

categories.label: Victory point track (before final scoring)
categories.labelVi: Điểm trên track (trước tính điểm cuối)
categories.hint: Total on the VP track, incl. completed regions, phase bonuses, bonus tiles, animals, sales. Add 100/200 if tile flipped

categories.label: Unsold goods tiles
categories.hint: 1 VP per goods tile left in storage

categories.label: Tile 15: goods types sold
categories.labelVi: Ô vàng 15: loại hàng đã bán
categories.hint: 2 VP per different goods type sold (needs tile 15)

categories.label: Tiles 16-23: matching buildings
categories.labelVi: Ô vàng 16-23: công trình tương ứng
categories.hint: 4 VP per building of each type whose yellow tile you own

categories.label: Tile 24: animal types
categories.hint: 4 VP per animal type in your estate (needs tile 24)

categories.label: Tile 25: sold goods tiles
categories.labelVi: Ô vàng 25: số hàng đã bán
categories.hint: 1 VP per sold goods tile (needs tile 25)

categories.label: Tile 26: bonus tiles claimed
categories.labelVi: Ô vàng 26: ô thưởng đã nhận
categories.hint: 3 VP per bonus tile owned, large or small (needs tile 26)

categories.label: Empty estate spaces (tiebreaker)
categories.labelVi: Ô trống trong điền trang (phân định hòa)
categories.hint: Count empty hex spaces on your duchy board; fewer wins the first tiebreak.

categories.label: Final turn order position, including stack order (tiebreaker)
categories.labelVi: Vị trí thứ tự lượt cuối, gồm thứ tự xếp chồng (phân định hòa)
categories.hint: Enter each player's final rank from first (1) to last; for markers on the same space, use their top-to-bottom stack order. The player farthest behind wins the second tiebreak.

tiebreakers.description: Still tied: the player who went later in turn order wins

notes: family: point-salad-euro (running-track + end bonuses). Base-game scoring verified against the Special Edition rulebook: points during play already sit on the VP track; final scoring adds unsold goods (1 each), Silverlings (1 each), every 2 workers (1), and VP-bearing yellow tiles. Unplaced hex tiles in storage score nothing. Tiebreaks are executable: fewest empty estate spaces, then later in turn order. Special Edition expansions and solo target are not modelled.
